workflow.name: Cisco Intersight - Start operating system installation
workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Start operating system installation

properties.description: Starts a vMedia OS installation for one Blade or Rack Unit and optionally polls five times. Select an intersight.endpoint target authorized to read organizations, inventory, catalogs, targets/installs and create/read os.Install. It requires exact inputs/cardinality, server type, a Supported configuration without unresolved placeholders, fully imported OS and model-compatible SCU/OSDU images, and the exact valid target. Only PhysicalDisk/VirtualDrive identities are normalized; future FC/iSCSI targets require validation and unknown/abstract targets fail closed. v1 omits answers, credentials, networking, and storage construction. Final exact-name preflight and POST can race. HTTP 200 means accepted, not complete, unless OperState is CompletedOk/Warning; CompletedError fails. Pending/InProgress may poll five times within 1-600 seconds. Inspect before retrying an ambiguous mutation/poll. Content resolution and bounded polling are inlined in this standalone export; no embedded workflow import is required.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Start operating system installation

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization used to scope server, configuration-file, and installation-name resolution.

properties.name: Installation Name
properties.description: New exact os.Install name. No production job name is prepopulated; an organization-scoped duplicate-name preflight runs immediately before create.

properties.name: Server Name or Serial
properties.description: Exact server Name or Serial within Device Organization. The resolved PhysicalSummary must retain concrete compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit SourceObjectType.

properties.name: OS Configuration File
properties.description: Exact os.ConfigurationFile Name or Moid within Device Organization. v1 requires a fully materialized file with no unresolved Placeholders.

properties.name: Operating System Image
properties.description: Exact softwarerepository.OperatingSystemFile Name or Moid. The selected image must be fully Imported with 100 percent ImportProgress and positive Size.

properties.name: SCU or OSDU Image
properties.description: Exact firmware.ServerConfigurationUtilityDistributable Name or Moid. It must support the exact server model and be in a stable usable repository state.

properties.name: Install Target
properties.description: Required JSON object for one concrete os.PhysicalDisk, os.VirtualDrive, os.FibreChannelTarget, or os.IscsiTarget. It must exactly match one target returned by ValidInstallTargets after schema-proven response normalization. Abstract os.SanTarget is rejected.

properties.name: Override Secure Boot
properties.description: Passed explicitly as OverrideSecureBoot on the validated vMedia os.Install request.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When false, return the documented HTTP 200 accepted resource without claiming completion. When true, poll the exact os.Install at most five times.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Required from 1 through 600 when Wait for Completion is true; otherwise must remain numeric 0.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final status. Documented successful create and completed polling paths use 200; validation/resolution conflicts use 4xx; helper/API/poll failures use 5xx.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable outcome distinguishing an accepted install resource from confirmed CompletedOk or CompletedWarning completion.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail. Empty only for a validated accepted or completed result.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured JSON containing exact organization/server/resource/target/install identity, accepted-versus-completed state, idempotency preflight, and readiness caveats.

properties.name: Polling Attempt
properties.description: Tracks the current bounded OS installation status poll from 1 through 5.

properties.name: Last OS Installation Poll Result
properties.description: Caches the latest validated nonterminal OS installation poll result for the exhaustion path outside the bounded loop.

properties.description: Requires collection shape, exact cardinality/name/discriminators, and a URL-safe Moid.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expected = sys.argv[2]
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Organization response is missing Results")
organizationMoid = ""
if len(values) == 0:
    organizationStatus = "not-found"; organizationMessage = "No exact organization matched Device Organization."
elif len(values) > 1:
    organizationStatus = "ambiguous"; organizationMessage = "Multiple organizations matched Device Organization."
else:
    item = values[0]
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expected or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid) is None:
        organizationStatus = "invalid"; organizationMessage = "Organization identity, discriminator, exact name, or URL-safe Moid is invalid."
    else:
        organizationStatus = "exact"; organizationMoid = moid; organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization identity was validated."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"status": organizationStatus, "message": organizationMessage, "organizationName": expected, "organizationMoid": organizationMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = organizationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(organizationMessage and organizationResultJson) and (organizationStatus != "exact" or bool(organizationMoid))

properties.description: Injects only the validated URL-safe organization Moid into five previously escaped route templates and rejects unresolved placeholders.
properties.script:
import sys
organizationMoid = sys.argv[1]
templates = sys.argv[2:]
if not organizationMoid or any(template.count("{organizationMoid}") != 1 for template in templates):
    raise ValueError("Every route template must contain exactly one organization placeholder")
routes = [template.replace("{organizationMoid}", organizationMoid) for template in templates]
if any("{" in route or "}" in route or organizationMoid not in route for route in routes):
    raise ValueError("A finalized route is unresolved")
serverApiUrl, configApiUrl, imageApiUrl, scuApiUrl, duplicateApiUrl = routes
helperReady = all(routes)

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Inspect exact OS installation content

properties.description: Validates the three exact read-only content responses in one bounded helper while preserving cardinality, discriminator, permission, readiness, placeholder, import, size, vendor, and server-model checks.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

resolverReady = False
resolverStatusCode = "500"
resolverStatusMessage = "OS installation content inspection did not complete."
resolverErrorMessage = resolverStatusMessage
resolverResultJson = json.dumps({"error":resolverStatusMessage,"requestAccepted":False}, separators=(",", ":"))
configMoid = ""
configResolution = ""
osImageMoid = ""
osImageResolution = ""
scuMoid = ""
scuResolution = ""

def inspect_resource(raw, kind, selector, organization_moid, server_model):
    payload = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError(kind + " response is not a JSON object")
    values = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError(kind + " response is missing Results")
    definitions = {
        "configuration": ("os.ConfigurationFile", "OS Configuration File"),
        "operating-system-image": ("softwarerepository.OperatingSystemFile", "Operating System Image"),
        "scu-image": ("firmware.ServerConfigurationUtilityDistributable", "SCU or OSDU Image"),
    }
    object_type, label = definitions[kind]
    def safe_moid(value):
        return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None
    def organization_present(entries):
        return isinstance(entries, list) and any(
            isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("Moid") == organization_moid
            and value.get("ObjectType") in (None, "organization.Organization")
            for value in entries
        )
    resource_moid = ""
    resource_name = ""
    if len(values) == 0:
        status = "not-found"
        message = "No exact organization-permitted " + label + " matched Name or Moid."
    elif len(values) > 1:
        status = "ambiguous"
        message = "Multiple " + label + " resources matched Name or Moid."
    else:
        item = values[0]
        problems = []
        readiness = []
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            problems.append(label + " result is not an object.")
        else:
            if item.get("Name") != selector and item.get("Moid") != selector:
                problems.append(label + " matches neither exact Name nor exact Moid.")
            if item.get("ObjectType") != object_type or item.get("ClassId") != object_type:
                problems.append(label + " discriminators are invalid.")
            if not safe_moid(item.get("Moid")):
                problems.append(label + " Moid is missing or unsafe.")
            if not isinstance(item.get("Name"), str) or not item.get("Name"):
                problems.append(label + " Name is missing.")
            if not organization_present(item.get("PermissionResources")):
                problems.append(label + " does not retain the exact organization permission relationship.")
            if kind == "configuration":
                if item.get("Supported") is not True:
                    readiness.append("OS Configuration File Supported must be true.")
                if item.get("Placeholders") not in (None, []):
                    readiness.append("OS Configuration File has unresolved Placeholders; v1 deliberately supplies no Answers.")
            elif kind == "operating-system-image":
                if item.get("ImportState") != "Imported":
                    readiness.append("Operating System Image ImportState must be exactly Imported.")
                progress = item.get("ImportProgress")
                if isinstance(progress, bool) or not isinstance(progress, int) or progress != 100:
                    readiness.append("Operating System Image ImportProgress must be numeric 100.")
                size = item.get("Size")
                if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
                    readiness.append("Operating System Image Size must be a positive integer.")
            else:
                if item.get("ImportState") != "Imported":
                    readiness.append("SCU or OSDU Image ImportState must be exactly Imported.")
                size = item.get("Size")
                if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
                    readiness.append("SCU or OSDU Image Size must be a positive integer.")
                models = item.get("SupportedModels")
                if not isinstance(models, list) or server_model not in models:
                    readiness.append("SCU or OSDU Image SupportedModels does not contain the exact server Model.")
                if item.get("Vendor") not in (None, "", "Cisco"):
                    readiness.append("SCU or OSDU Image Vendor is not Cisco.")
        if problems:
            status = "invalid"
            message = " ".join(problems)
        elif readiness:
            status = "unusable"
            message = " ".join(readiness)
        else:
            status = "exact"
            message = "Exactly one ready and compatible " + label + " was validated."
            resource_moid = item["Moid"]
            resource_name = item["Name"]
    return {
        "status": status,
        "message": message,
        "kind": kind,
        "objectType": object_type,
        "selector": selector,
        "resourceMoid": resource_moid or None,
        "resourceName": resource_name or None,
        "organizationMoid": organization_moid,
        "serverModel": server_model if kind == "scu-image" else None,
    }

try:
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[7]
    serverModel = sys.argv[8]
    configuration = inspect_resource(sys.argv[1], "configuration", sys.argv[4], organizationMoid, serverModel)
    operatingSystemImage = inspect_resource(sys.argv[2], "operating-system-image", sys.argv[5], organizationMoid, serverModel)
    scuImage = inspect_resource(sys.argv[3], "scu-image", sys.argv[6], organizationMoid, serverModel)
    configResolution = json.dumps(configuration, separators=(",", ":"))
    osImageResolution = json.dumps(operatingSystemImage, separators=(",", ":"))
    scuResolution = json.dumps(scuImage, separators=(",", ":"))
    configMoid = configuration.get("resourceMoid") or ""
    osImageMoid = operatingSystemImage.get("resourceMoid") or ""
    scuMoid = scuImage.get("resourceMoid") or ""
    resources = [configuration, operatingSystemImage, scuImage]
    failed = next((value for value in resources if value.get("status") != "exact"), None)
    if failed is None:
        resolverReady = True
        resolverStatusCode = "200"
        resolverStatusMessage = "All OS installation content was resolved exactly"
        resolverErrorMessage = ""

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Initialize bounded OS installation polling

properties.description: Creates one deadline and safe delays for exactly five item-GET poll attempts inside the validated 1-600 second bound; each delay remains below the 180-second helper timeout.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time
timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600: raise ValueError("Wait timeout must be from 1 through 600 seconds")
now = time.time(); initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0)); pollInterval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
if initialDelay >= 180.0 or pollInterval >= 180.0: raise ValueError("Derived delay exceeds helper timeout")
deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout); initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay; pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % pollInterval
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"waitTimeoutSeconds":timeout,"initialDelaySeconds":initialDelay,"pollIntervalSeconds":pollInterval,"maximumPollAttempts":5,"documentedTerminalStates":["CompletedOk","CompletedWarning","CompletedError"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = bool(deadlineEpoch and initialDelaySeconds and pollIntervalSeconds and pollingResultJson)

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Wait before OS installation polling attempt

properties.description: Uses the initial delay for attempt 1 and the shared interval for attempts 2-5, never sleeping past the validated OS installation deadline.
properties.display_name: Wait before OS installation polling attempt
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
    raise ValueError("Polling attempt must be from 1 through 5")
requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
    raise ValueError("Polling delay is outside safe helper bound")
stage = "OS installation poll " + str(attempt)
remaining = deadline - time.time()
if remaining <= 0:
    waitStatus = "timeout"
    waitMessage = "The OS installation wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted":True,"completed":False,"timeout":True,"stage":stage,"attempt":attempt}, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
    time.sleep(actualDelay)
    waitStatus = "ready"
    waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage":stage,"attempt":attempt,"requestedDelaySeconds":requestedDelay,"actualDelaySeconds":actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = waitStatus in ("ready","timeout") and bool(waitMessage and waitResultJson)
